name: Cross-Bridge
description: CrossBridge links a Telegram chat with a WhatsApp number in real time — text, media, delivery receipts, optional AI translation and summaries, with a live pipeline dashboard.

paragraphs: Telegram ⇄ WhatsApp, in real time. CrossBridge links a Telegram chat (private or group) with a WhatsApp number. Text, photos, voice notes, videos and documents cross both ways in about a second, with delivery receipts, optional AI translation and on-demand summaries. A web dashboard shows every message's path through the pipeline, and a live simulator lets anyone try it without a phone.
features: Pair in a minute with a code. Send /start to the bot on Telegram (or add it to a group), get a code like CB-7K2PQ, and send that code on WhatsApp. It works the other way round too: send link on WhatsApp and /link…
Both directions, all common media. Text, photos, voice notes, videos and documents up to 5 MB. Media is copied to Netlify Blobs and served from a short-lived URL that Telegram and Twilio fetch.
Sender names (on or off), "edited" markers for edited Telegram messages, and HTML escaping so nothing a user types can break the formatting.
Chat commands on both sides: /status, /summary, /translate hi (or off), /pause, /resume, /unlink, /help, and /login on Telegram.
Delivery receipts. Twilio status callbacks move each message through queued → sent → delivered → read, and never backwards.

whatItDoes.text: Telegram ⇄ WhatsApp, in real time. CrossBridge links a Telegram chat (private or group) with a WhatsApp number. Text, photos, voice notes, videos and documents cross both ways in about a second, with delivery receipts, optional AI translation and on-demand summaries. A web dashboard shows every message's path through the pipeline, and a live simulator lets anyone try it without a phone.

requirements.text: Chat commands on both sides: /status, /summary, /translate hi (or off), /pause, /resume, /unlink, /help, and /login on Telegram.
Dashboard with no passwords: /login in a private Telegram chat returns a one-time sign-in link (10 minutes).
You need a Telegram bot, a Twilio account with the WhatsApp sandbox, and (optionally) a Gemini API key.
